spl-token.name: SPL Token
spl-token.description: Create a Solana SPL token program using Anchor. Include mint, transfer, and burn instructions. Use Anchor's #[account] macros for account validation.
spl-token.promptTemplate: Create a Solana SPL token program using Anchor. Include mint, transfer, and burn instructions. Use Anchor's #[account] macros for account validation.

nft-collection.name: NFT Collection
nft-collection.description: Create a Solana NFT collection program using Anchor with Metaplex standards. Include mint_nft, update_metadata, and verify_collection instructions.
nft-collection.promptTemplate: Create a Solana NFT collection program using Anchor with Metaplex standards. Include mint_nft, update_metadata, and verify_collection instructions.

staking.name: Staking Program
staking.description: Create a Solana staking program using Anchor. Users can stake SOL, earn rewards over time, and unstake. Include reward calculation based on time staked.
staking.promptTemplate: Create a Solana staking program using Anchor. Users can stake SOL, earn rewards over time, and unstake. Include reward calculation based on time staked.

escrow.name: Escrow
escrow.description: Create a Solana escrow program using Anchor. Allow two parties to swap tokens atomically with cancel and execute instructions.
escrow.promptTemplate: Create a Solana escrow program using Anchor. Allow two parties to swap tokens atomically with cancel and execute instructions.

dao-voting.name: DAO Voting
dao-voting.description: Create a simple Solana DAO voting program using Anchor. Members can create proposals, vote yes/no, and execute proposals that pass threshold.
dao-voting.promptTemplate: Create a simple Solana DAO voting program using Anchor. Members can create proposals, vote yes/no, and execute proposals that pass threshold.

erc20-token.name: ERC-20 Token
erc20-token.description: Create an ERC-20 token contract using Solidity 0.8+. Include mint (owner only), burn, and transfer. Use OpenZeppelin's ERC20 base. Add constructor params for name, symbol, and initial supply.
erc20-token.promptTemplate: Create an ERC-20 token contract using Solidity 0.8+. Include mint (owner only), burn, and transfer. Use OpenZeppelin's ERC20 base. Add constructor params for name, symbol, and initial supply.

erc721-nft.name: ERC-721 NFT
erc721-nft.description: Create an ERC-721 NFT contract using Solidity 0.8+ with OpenZeppelin. Include safeMint with tokenURI, royalties (ERC-2981), and max supply limit.
erc721-nft.promptTemplate: Create an ERC-721 NFT contract using Solidity 0.8+ with OpenZeppelin. Include safeMint with tokenURI, royalties (ERC-2981), and max supply limit.

simple-vault.name: Simple Vault
simple-vault.description: Create a Solidity vault contract that accepts ETH deposits, tracks balances per user, and allows withdrawals. Include emergency withdraw for owner. Use ReentrancyGuard.
simple-vault.promptTemplate: Create a Solidity vault contract that accepts ETH deposits, tracks balances per user, and allows withdrawals. Include emergency withdraw for owner. Use ReentrancyGuard.

dex-amm.name: DEX (AMM)
dex-amm.description: Create a simple constant-product AMM (x*y=k) in Solidity. Include addLiquidity, removeLiquidity, and swap functions. Calculate fees at 0.3%.
dex-amm.promptTemplate: Create a simple constant-product AMM (x*y=k) in Solidity. Include addLiquidity, removeLiquidity, and swap functions. Calculate fees at 0.3%.

governance.name: Governance
governance.description: Create a Solidity governance contract using OpenZeppelin Governor. Include propose, vote, queue, and execute. Voting period 1 week, quorum 4%.
governance.promptTemplate: Create a Solidity governance contract using OpenZeppelin Governor. Include propose, vote, queue, and execute. Voting period 1 week, quorum 4%.
